## Change / 改动

What changed and why? For an upstream update, include old/new commits.

## Validation / 验证

Commands run, observed results, and anything not checked.

## Checklist

- [ ] Catalog and relevant GUIDE agree; sources and licenses are referenced.
- [ ] Validation status reflects only actual execution evidence.
- [ ] `python scripts/toolbox.py validate` and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] No caches, credentials, private content, vendored projects, or rendered media.
- [ ] Manual-only upstream update policy is preserved.
